The Town Clerk's office will be open from # Town Meeting & Election The Town of Sutton is governed by General Bylaws, Home Rule Charter, Massachusetts General Law, and other relevant statutes. The Town's form of government, an elected, five-member Select Board appoints a Town Manager to administer the daily operation of the Town. The Town's legislative body is Open Town Meeting. According to the General Bylaws, the Town Manager must submit a balanced budget annually to the Select Board and Finance and Warrant Advisory Committee. The budget is reviewed by the Select Board before being moved to the Finance and Warrant Advisory Committee. The Finance and Warrant Advisory Committee reviews the annual operating budget and other warrant articles and submits their recommendations to Town Meeting. Town Meeting then votes to adopt the annual operating budget and other warrant articles at the Annual Town Meeting. Information related to the budget process, town meeting and the town election can be found below. # Election The 2026 election season includes two important statewide elections: the State Primary Election on Tuesday, September 1, 2026, and the State General Election on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. These elections determine who will represent Massachusetts at the federal, state, county, and local levels. ### State General Election – November 3, 2026 The General Election is when all registered voters cast their ballots to elect public officials. The ballot will include candidates for offices such as Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Secretary of the Commonwealth, Treasurer, Auditor, U.S. Senator, U.S. Representative, State Senator, State Representative, and other offices that may vary by community. ### Important Election Dates * State General Election: Tuesday, November 3, 2026 * General Election Voter Registration Deadline: October 24, 2026 * General Election Early Voting: October 17–30, 2026 * General Election Vote-by-Mail Application Deadline: October 27, 2026  CLICK HERE for Early Voting schedule CLICK HERE for General Election Warrant CLICK HERE to view SPECIMEN Ballot 2026 CLICK HERE to view the Ballot Questions Summary 2026  CLICK HERE to view Ballot Questions Guide 2026  # Town Meeting The Town of Sutton follows a traditional open town meeting process, which provides an important platform for residents to engage in local governance. Town meetings are typically held twice a year, in the spring (the 2nd Monday of May) and in the fall (the 3rd Monday of October). Voters gather to discuss and decide on key community issues, including budgets, zoning laws, and other local policies. In this forum, residents can propose, debate, and vote on a range of topics, ensuring that decisions reflect the collective voice of the town. The meeting is designed to be accessible and transparent, fostering active community participation in shaping the future of Sutton. ### Fall Town Meeting Date - October 19, 2026 Check-in begins at 6:30 pm, and the Meeting starts promptly at 7 pm Middle School/High School Auditorium 383 Boston Road * CLICK HERE to review the Commonwealth of Massacusetts/Office of Attorney General Open Meeting Law Guide * CLICK HERE to view the Town Meeting Schedule and Deadlines * Last day to register for Town Meeting is October 9, 2026.  The Town Clerk's office will be open from 9am to 5pm. * CLICK HERE for ALL chronological information and links to related board meetings discussing the Fall 2026 Town Meeting * CLICK HERE for the Town Warrant * CLICK HERE for Virtual Town Warrant * CLICK HERE for the Town Meeting Guide * CLICK HERE for Warrant Articles YES Vote vs. NO Vote * CLICK HERE for the Town Meeting Packet * CLICK HERE for Postcard mailing ### Contact Us 1. #### Laura Caruso Town Clerk 2. #### Budget / Town Meeting & Election Physical Address [Button: View Map] 4 Uxbridge Road Sutton, MA 01590 4 Uxbridge Road Sutton MA 01590 Directions Phone: 508-865-8725 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- News Flash • Sutton, MA (https://www.suttonma.gov/m/newsflash?cat=7) citeturn144search2 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: 3 days ago; The Town of Sutton is pleased to announce that the Highway Department submitted and was awarded 𝐭𝐰𝐨 𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐞𝐝 𝐟𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐛𝐚𝐜𝐤 𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐧𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐮𝐬𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐬 𝐃𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 (𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐃𝐎𝐓) 𝐌𝐮𝐧𝐢𝐜𝐢𝐩𝐚𝐥 𝐒𝐩𝐞𝐞𝐝 𝐅𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐛𝐚𝐜𝐤 𝐒𝐢𝐠𝐧𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐦. ... Here are the election results for Sutton Massachusetts, organized by the year of the election. ## Elections Sutton Massachusetts Massachusetts is a heavily Democratic state, but Sutton tends to be quite independently minded. For example in 2008 when almost the entire state of Massachusetts voted for Obama, Sutton was one of the only towns which voted for McCain. Here are the election results for Sutton Massachusetts, organized by the year of the election. 2010 Election Results We repealed the alcohol sales tax, but voted not to reduce the overall sales tax. 2008 Election Results The dog racing ban succeeded this year. Marijuana was decriminalized for small amounts (a fine, no jail time). An attempt to completely repeal the income tax was defeated. 2006 Election Results Wine sales in food stores was defeated. 2004 Election Results Worcester county wholeheartedly endored allowing marijuana use for medical reasons, in a non-binding ballot. 2002 Election Results Romney came in as governor. 2000 Election Results A dog racing ban failed. Voters DID vote to reduce state income tax from from 5.95% to 5%. However, the Mass legislature then ignored those results.
